name: ztd-charts-mcp

tools.name: list_charts
tools.description: List the 37 chart types with name, level (basic, intermediate, advanced), group, one-line summary, when to use or avoid, and encoding channels. Filter by group or level.

tools.name: get_chart_schema
tools.description: Get the JSON Schema for one chart type (encoding channels, options with types/defaults), plus a complete example spec and a React snippet. Omit type for the full schema of all 37 charts (about 275 KB, so prefer asking for one type).

type.description: Chart type, e.g. "pie", "line", "sankey". Aliases like "doughnut", "violin" work.

tools.name: validate_spec
tools.description: Validate a chart spec against the registry and its inline data: unknown type (with did-you-mean), missing/unknown encoding channels, fields missing from data, non-numeric value fields, option types and enums. Returns { valid, errors[], warnings[] } with JSON paths and messages. Set locale for the language of the messages.

spec.description: { type, data, encoding, options?, card?, theme? }

locale.description: Locale for the error and warning messages. Default "en-US", or the spec's options.locale when set. "ko" or "ko-KR" gives Korean messages

tools.name: render_chart
tools.description: Server-render a chart spec to PNG (returned as an image) and/or SVG text, with the card frame (number, title, legend, takeaway, level badge) when spec.card is set. Also returns ready-to-paste React code. data may be inline rows, { csv }, or { url } (fetched; private and local network addresses are refused unless the server runs with ZTD_CHARTS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_URLS=1). Set locale for the language of built-in chart text and number formats.

locale.description: Locale for built-in chart text and number formats. Default "en-US" (1.2K). "ko" or "ko-KR" gives Korean text and 1.2만 style numbers

tools.name: suggest_chart
tools.description: Profile tabular data (column kinds, cardinality, hierarchy, source/target pairs, dates) and recommend chart types ranked by fit, each with a reason and a ready spec. Pass csv text, rows (array of objects), or a url to CSV/JSON (Google Sheets CSV export, REST; private and local network addresses are refused unless the server runs with ZTD_CHARTS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_URLS=1). Set locale for the language of the reasons and the suggested specs.

url.description: http(s) URL returning CSV or JSON

locale.description: Locale for chart names, reasons and card text in the suggestions. Default "en-US". "ko" or "ko-KR" gives Korean text and sets options.locale "ko-KR" in each spec

instructions: ztd-charts: 37 animated React chart types driven by a JSON spec { type, data, encoding, options, card }. Typical flow: suggest_chart (or list_charts) -> get_chart_schema -> write a spec -> validate_spec -> render_chart to preview -> use the returned React snippet. Built-in chart text (tooltips, screen reader text, badges) and number formats are English by default. For Korean, pass locale "ko" to render_chart or set options.locale in the spec, and write card text in Korean. validate_spec and suggest_chart take locale too.
